stem: Major surface currents of the ocean are shown in the diagram.
instruction: Ocean currents affect weather patterns by —

options.label: F
options.text: regulating when tides occur in coastal areas

options.label: G
options.text: trapping heat at the equator to regulate the global climate

options.label: H
options.text: distributing heat from the uneven absorption of solar energy

options.label: J
options.text: increasing the rate of evaporation to transport water to areas experiencing droughts

visual_elements: map with arrows showing major ocean surface currents
